charts.cost_desc: Stacked by {{group}}. The seven largest groups get their own color; the rest are Other.
charts.tokens_desc: Each kind has its own scale; cache reads are often 100× the rest.
charts.percentile_desc: p50 solid, p95 dashed, per provider.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.desc: Newest first. A session that switches accounts lands on a cold prompt cache, so its next request writes the whole prefix again.
sessions.scope_all_one: Covers the {{count}} session in this range.
sessions.scope_all_other: Covers all {{count}} sessions in this range.
sessions.scope_partial_one: Covers only the {{count}} most recent session loaded so far. The range has more; load more sessions below to include them.
sessions.scope_partial_other: Covers only the {{count}} most recent sessions loaded so far. The range has more; load more sessions below to include them.
sessions.excess_hint: Cache writes beyond the stable sessions' share for the same prompt volume
sessions.empty_switched: No session in this range switched accounts.
sessions.empty_switched_partial_one: The {{count}} session loaded so far did not switch accounts. Load more to check the rest of the range.
sessions.empty_switched_partial_other: None of the {{count}} sessions loaded so far switched accounts. Load more to check the rest of the range.
sessions.truncated_note: A request count ending in + marks a session with more than 50,000 requests in this range. Its row covers only the first 50,000.

detail.unpriced: No price matches this model, so it counts as $0.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.desc: USD per million tokens. A pattern may end in * to match model versions; an exact name wins over a pattern, then the longest pattern.
pricing.reprice_note: Cost is computed when you query, so saving reprices all history: every total and chart on this page.
pricing.openai_note: For OpenAI models the 5m and 1h columns hold the 30-minute and 12-hour cache-write prices.
pricing.reset_shipped_message: Every price is replaced with the prices this taproot release ships. Rows you added or edited are lost, and so are unsaved changes. Cost is computed when you query, so this reprices all past usage: every total and chart, not only new requests.
pricing.reset_shipped_done: Prices reset to the shipped prices. All past usage now uses them.
pricing.saved: Prices saved. Costs now use the new prices.
pricing.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
pricing.error_number: Enter a number of 0 or more
pricing.coverage_desc: Which price applies to each model seen in the selected range.
pricing.empty: No prices yet. Add one to start pricing usage.

devices.title: Devices
devices.desc: Usage by the device that sent each request, as the access guard identified it. A plugin's own requests, such as Claude Keep Rolling's pings, show under the plugin's name. No caller recorded holds requests the server has no caller for, such as plugin pings from before plugins were attributed, and requests through routes without a request ID.
devices.ttl_desc: Flags a device when more than {{share}} of its Claude main-conversation cache writes were 5-minute, over at least {{min}} requests with a reported split. Subagent requests are left out: Claude Code sets their TTL separately.
devices.ttl_measured: Measured: {{fiveMinute}} tokens written with a 5-minute TTL and {{oneHour}} with a one-hour TTL, over {{requests}} main-conversation requests.
devices.ttl_keep: Keep the 5-minute TTL on {{device}} for now: by the estimate below, a one-hour TTL would have cost about {{amount}} more in this range.
devices.ttl_fix_version: (Claude Code 2.1.242 or later). The main conversation then writes with a one-hour TTL.
devices.estimate_rewrites_one: {{count}} cache write of {{tokens}} tokens followed a 5 to 60 minute pause, so a one-hour TTL would likely have read it instead (about {{cost}}). Writing the rest at the one-hour rate would add about {{premium}}.
devices.estimate_rewrites_other: {{count}} cache writes totalling {{tokens}} tokens followed a 5 to 60 minute pause, so a one-hour TTL would likely have read them instead (about {{cost}}). Writing the rest at the one-hour rate would add about {{premium}}.
devices.estimate_none: No cache write followed a 5 to 60 minute pause in this range. Writing at the one-hour rate would add about {{premium}}.
devices.estimate_net_saving: Net: about {{amount}} saved at API prices.
devices.estimate_net_cost: Net: about {{amount}} more at API prices.
